# Power House Gym & Fitness Center

> Power House Gym & Fitness Center is a premier strength, bodybuilding, and fitness training facility located in Shahupuri, Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India. Founded and led by certified Head Coach Ameer Mullani (12+ years experience), the gym provides structured regular memberships, 1-on-1 personal training, and customized Indian diet plans.

## Facility & Business Information
- **Full Legal/Trade Name**: Power House Gym & Fitness Center
- **Alternate Name**: Power House Gym Shahupuri
- **Founder & Head Coach**: Ameer Mullani
- **Experience**: 12+ Years Coaching & Transformation Experience
- **Active Community**: 200+ Active Members
- **Rating**: 4.4 / 5.0 (Google verified rating across 48+ member reviews)
- **Facility Address**: Vardhmane House, 718, 3rd Lane, near Nitin Medical, E Ward, Shahupuri, Kolhapur, Maharashtra 416001, India
- **Coordinates (Geo/ICBM)**: 16.704987, 74.243253
- **Primary Phone**: +91 9860252720
- **Official WhatsApp**: +91 9860252720
- **Official Email**: amirmullani7272@gmail.com

## Operating Hours
- **Monday – Saturday (Split Shift)**:
  - Morning Shift: 6:00 AM – 11:30 AM IST
  - Evening Shift: 4:30 PM – 9:00 PM IST
- **Sunday**: Closed (Facility maintenance and member recovery)

## Pricing & Membership Plans
### Regular Gym Memberships
- **1 Month**: ₹1,500
- **3 Months**: ₹4,000 (₹1,333/month)
- **6 Months**: ₹6,000 (₹1,000/month)
- **1 Year**: ₹9,000 (₹750/month)

### Personal Training (1-on-1 Dedicated Coaching by Ameer Mullani)
- **1 Month**: ₹6,000
- **3 Months**: ₹15,000 (₹5,000/month)
- **6 Months**: ₹27,500 (₹4,583/month)
- **1 Year**: ₹52,500 (₹4,375/month)

### Add-Ons & Passes
- **Custom Diet & Nutrition Plan**: ₹800 (One-time, tailored to everyday local Indian/Kolhapuri diet, vegetarian, eggetarian, or non-veg)
- **Complimentary 1-Day Trial Pass**: Free (Includes full workout session, facility walkthrough, and coach consultation with zero joining pressure)
